meta.name: Little Disasters
meta.description: When Jess takes her baby to hospital with an unexplained head injury, her close friend, A&E doctor Liz, makes the excruciating decision to call social services, igniting an explosive chain of events.

videos.title: The Perfect Mother
videos.overview: Jess takes her baby to A&E. Liz, duty Doctor and friend, calls Social Services.

videos.title: You Think You Know Someone
videos.overview: Police and Social Services investigate. The group's tensions begin on holiday.

videos.title: One Of Them Is Lying
videos.overview: As the investigation continues, cracks form and shocking discoveries are made.

videos.title: Nowhere Safe
videos.overview: The threat of Social Services splitting up the Carrisfords' family closes in.

videos.title: Unravelling
videos.overview: The group deal with the fallout of Jess' shocking actions, nearing the truth.

videos.title: What Have You Done?
videos.overview: The truth remains out of reach, but the summer fair leads to a shocking reveal.
